themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with tools to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and optimizing code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered tools designed to assist researchers in various stages of the research process, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Encompasses AI applications that condense large amounts of text into concise summaries, reports, or insights.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, skills requirements, and the overall employment landscape.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores the use of AI in automating or enhancing usability testing processes and evaluations.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications that specifically aid in the user experience design and user research workflows.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Details research findings and studies related to the behavior, capabilities, and implications of AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI tools and methods for analyzing and understanding user sentiment from feedback and text data.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Addresses the creation and use of artificial users or personas for testing and research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
